description: Create the payment link for a business's own carrier registration (a one-time filing fee plus a monthly campaign fee). Business owner only, and only once the details and the EIN are saved. Returns checkout_url for the owner to open and pay; nothing is charged by this tool, and filing starts only after payment. A checkout_url means neither payment nor filing. On a plan that includes registration there is nothing to pay: the tool sends it to the carriers straight away and returns included_in_plan and filed true instead of a link, so that path requires confirm_submission true, which records that the owner reviewed and confirmed the saved details and external submission. Submission is not carrier approval. The tool takes no EIN, document contents, credentials or legal attestations.

confirm_submission.description: True only after the owner explicitly confirms the saved details and possible immediate carrier submission.
